Louisiana Tech ranks 50th on offense, converting on 43.8% of third downs. UL Monroe is 103rd in the FBS with a -3 turnover margin, compared to Louisiana Tech's 26th-ranked +4 margin. Louisiana Tech ranks 85th in the FBS averaging 60.6 penalty yards per game, compared to UL Monroe's 8th-ranked 35.4 per-game average. Louisiana Tech ranks 119th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 75% of trips. Team leaders Louisiana Tech Passing: Blake Baker, 679 yards, 7 TDs, 1 INT, 67.9 completion percentage Rushing: Andrew Burnette, 207 yards on 43 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Jalen Mickens, 434 yards on 30 catches, 3 TDs UL Monroe Passing: Aidan Armenta, 855 yards, 6 TDs, 1 INT, 64.5 completion percentage Rushing: Austin Carlisle, 219 yards on 37 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Marcellus Jackson, 234 yards on 26 catches, 0 TDs Last game Louisiana Tech won 32-31 over Louisiana on Oct. 10. Armenta threw for 362 yards on 26-of-41 attempts (63.4%) with three touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball 10 times for 10 yards and one rushing touchdown.
